sources: https://www.brown.sd.us/department/fairgrounds-parks/camping (read 2026-11-21): 'The sites are rented out on a first come, first serve basis. In the Northwest area of the Fairgrounds there are 120 camping sites available with water and electricity and 116 sites with full hook-ups. In the Southwest portion of the fairgrounds are a number of sites with electricity and water. Just south of Centennial Village there is a smaller camping area that has 40 sites with water and electricity available. Camping Fees are $25.00 per night for sites with water and power hook-ups. Fees are $30.00 per night for sites with water, power and sewer hook-ups. During the Brown County Fair there are no camp sites available.'

note: Brown County fairgrounds campground on Aberdeen's west side: about 120 water/electric and 116 full-hookup sites in the north-west area, more water/electric sites in the south-west part and a 40-site water/electric area south of Centennial Village. First come, first served; no sites during the Brown County Fair (mid-August). Wylie Park and its city campground are next door to the north. --Claude
